dataset.title: Wellesley Adopt a Hydrant
dataset.description: The Adopt a Hydrant web mapping application connects community members with local fire hydrants. Residents can browse the map, view hydrant locations, check adoption status, and sign up to clear hydrants of snow in their neighborhood during the winter season. The application simplifies the adoption process and encourages civic engagement during winter months. By keeping hydrants clear of snow and ice, volunteers help improve emergency response times and support public safety. The application is maintained by the GIS team and designed for easy public use on both desktop and mobile devices.
